All 11 backend pytest tests pass (test_iter43_fix23_at_inventory_webhook_role.py). Frontend flows verified end-to-end: login OTP, create officine modal (full role dropdown incl. Pharmacie, successful POST), Rôle column + filter-role + manage-roles-inline-btn, EXCLAM_Liluvine H1 + page testid + sidebar link, AdminSettings → AT section + Inventory Bearer section + complete webhook URLs displayed. issues: React hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Caused by a dynamic <span> wrapper rendered inside <option> in a <select>. Not blocking but produces console warnings on every settings page load.
Initial page load takes ~6-8 seconds before all sections render (shows 78-90% loader during this time). Could be improved for UX but is functional.

Hydration error (span inside option) – HTML invalid; fix by removing the dynamic wrapper span around option text.
